review.subject: Surfboard-shaped bedroom rug with palm and wave design
review.summary: A very short AI-generated spot: a POV surfer carves a wave with a board matching the rug pattern, a spray-and-blue wash hides the cut, then the camera pulls out to reveal the rug on a coastal bedroom floor. A small AI-disclosure caption stays on screen throughout.

beats.note: Surfer on a pink palm-print board, tight low action shots.
Wave spray fills frame then washes to flat blue.
Close of rug, then pull-out to show full bedroom with rug.

shot_labels.note: Surfer legs and board, orbiting push-in
Surfer carves, sun flare, push and tilt
Water spray fills frame, quick pull-out

learn: Use a hero activity clip, with the product pattern on the actor's gear, then match-cut into the product (2.6s).
Hide the scene change under a spray or colour wash of about 0.7s.
Reveal the product by one slow pull-out of about 2.4s from a close detail to the full room.
Keep the whole spot near 6s for a loopable vertical teaser.
